decisions.reason: The multi-model illuminated candle arch line sits close to the core Erzgebirge offer and was promoted on the home page, so management will continue it as part of the seasonal range.
The one-tier pyramid fits the traditional craft range at low incremental cost, so management keeps it even though it has not been observed recently.

As the publicly positioned flagship line with several models and substantial development investment, the electronic music box is one management will persist with, attributing weak results to pandemic-era market conditions.
The motif platform is tied to the committed flagship music box system, which carries it forward despite low visibility and its distance from the core offer.
The Christmas platform supports the music box system management has committed to, and its weak seasonal results can still be blamed on temporary disruptions, so it is retained for now.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds on the established craft offer and was featured on the home page, so management keeps it in the seasonal range.
